sources.kind: publication supplement Data S1, Table S2 and LC-MS/MS methods

claims.value: 14 individual modern-grouper bone specimens, one RAW acquisition each
claims.evidence: Thirteen specimen identifiers in supplementary Table S2 match accession RAW stems. The remaining CAN2-2 RAW is named in CAN2_search.zip summary.txt. All 14 accession-scoped RAW names are unique and assigned once.

claims.value: five Epinephelus marginatus, three E. aeneus, three E. costae, three E. caninus
claims.evidence: Paper Methods states 5/3/3/3 specimen counts. Table S2 explicitly identifies WLAp 1082 as E. aeneus and 12 other RAW-matched specimens. CAN2_search.zip parameters.txt points to a Caninus species-library FASTA, and its summary.txt names the accession CAN2-2 RAW stem.

claims.location: characteristics[organism part], characteristics[material type], characteristics[pooled sample]
claims.evidence: Paper and supplement describe modern reference bone specimens sampled individually for collagen extraction. No pooling is described.
Each source name is a distinct specimen identifier. The integer is an annotation ordinal for unique specimens within each species, not a source-provided biological replicate label.
Supplemental protein extraction methods explicitly say specimens were digested with Trypsin. The three deposited MaxQuant summaries report Trypsin/P search specificity.

claims.location: comment[instrument], acquisition, dissociation, collision energy, MS1 scan range
claims.value: Orbitrap Exploris 480, top-10 DDA, HCD 30% NCE, 350-1400 m/z
claims.evidence: Supplemental LC-MS/MS methods give the exact instrument and acquisition settings; PRIDE protocol confirms Exploris 480 for reference LC-MS/MS.

claims.location: comment[precursor mass tolerance], comment[fragment mass tolerance]
claims.value: 10 ppm and 0.05 Da for pFind reconstruction search
claims.evidence: Paper and PRIDE processing protocol specify pFind precursor ±10 ppm and fragment ±0.05 Da; these differ from the separate MaxQuant validation search settings.

claims.value: fixed C carbamidomethyl; variable M oxidation, P hydroxylation, protein N-terminal acetylation, N/Q deamidation, Q/E pyroglutamate
claims.evidence: parameters.txt/summary.txt in 2020 AEN1 and 2022 CAN2/GUA7 MaxQuant archives agree on these search modifications. Hydroxyproline is represented by Unimod:35 Oxidation targeted to P; the same accession targeted to M represents methionine oxidation.

limitations: CAN-2 is absent from supplementary Table S2, but its deposited search archive explicitly uses a Caninus species library and names the CAN2-2 RAW stem. Its treatment/origin history is unavailable.

The AEN1 MaxQuant summary RAW stem says Ancient_bone whereas the accession RAW name says Modern_bone; the specimen code and date agree. The specimen's species also has independent support in Table S2.
The pFind mass tolerances and MaxQuant modification settings describe two documented analysis stages; the SDRF records the primary pFind tolerances and the deposited MaxQuant modification set.
Search modification agreement was checked in three representative archives, not all fourteen. Sex and developmental stage are not assigned to individual bone specimens in the sources.
The reconciliation helper reads only the PRIDE project JSON and flags Trypsin as unsupported; the publication supplement explicitly states Trypsin digestion.
